notes: Score-and-region reasoning with no content description. It is internally inconsistent in citing high localized manipulation probabilities as support for authenticity. Image A shows a boy bodyboarding on a FlowRider-style sheet wave; the bottom-center is board, hip and streaked whitewater. Motion streaking and blown highlights in the foam there are consistent with a moving water sheet, but they also make subtle artifacts unjudgeable.
